paragraphs: Rabbi Yirmiyah, son of Rabbi Shimon.

Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 1 in the Venice printing. Megillah 4:5 has “Rabbi Yirmiyah, Rabbi Shimon”; possibly it should read “Rabbi Yirmiyah, son of Rabbi Shimon.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman tentatively supplies a father-son link between the adjacent names; the Venice printing qualifies the Shabbat reference.

The complete Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:1 paragraph names Rabbi Yirmiyah berabbi Shimon. In the consulted Megillah 4:5 paragraph, Yirmiyah reports in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish; this does not independently establish Hyman’s adjacent bare-name reading or his tentative father–son correction. The Venice printing remains Hyman’s specified witness, not a newly inspected print.
